_about: Home cooking at the kitchen corner (house extension kitchen): E at the stove or the cupboard opens the cooking screen (Cooking, CookingMenu, CookingScreen; README.md, Cooking). A recipe's key is the dish it makes, a food in data/foods.json (eaten like any food). needs: what one cooking uses, each {item, n} (one item id) or {group, n} (any of a group below, its items in the order they are used up). Ingredients come out of the rucksack first, then the hand, then the storage chest; cooked rice, miso, soy, salt and oil are in the kitchen's own pantry and never run out (the rice crop is the farm's own new rice, a real ingredient). makes: how many dishes one cooking gives (1 if left out), into the rucksack. start: known from the start; any other recipe is known once its flag recipe_<id> is set (a villager's lesson or the radio, data/events/recipe_*.json; or card: the shipping buyer leaves a recipe card in the bin the first time that item is shipped), and flags are saved. tools: the kitchen tools a recipe needs (ids in tools above, each {name, price, about}); the Yorozu Store sells them once the kitchen corner is built (shops.json kitchen_tools), and the tools owned are saved (Game.kitchen_tools); the start recipes need none. taught: where the lesson comes from, for people reading this file. Dishes, names and numbers are ours; see WORKLOG 2026-10-31 Cooking, Daikon and rice, and Cooking tools, and 2026-11-01 Wild things in recipes (wild greens and mushrooms from data/forage.json, the cheapest used first; Haru, Genzo and Kiku teach once known to band 1, and the first bamboo shoot, chestnuts or matsutake shipped brings a card).
